Dense fitted segments — BLAZING smooth pale birch-blonde lacquered wood across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID dark walnut-brown ball joints standing out sharply against the pale wood, each with a steel pivot screw, and a thin black seam down the spine, smooth lacquered satin, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Background: the sandstone canyon floor in front of the rose-red Treasury at Petra, a smooth sandy path and standard-height rock-cut doorways, empty of tourists, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
